# Alphabet

Alphabet is a public company founded in 2015 and headquartered in Mountain View, California, United States. According to its own website, Alphabet presents itself through its Investor Relations division.

The company faces significant legal exposure, with 220 cases tracked in California across theworldofai.org's database. No specific AI products, MCP servers, or patent filings are currently recorded in the held facts for this company profile.
